integrity: Proof is independent of finite verification; computations cover stated bounded parameters and are not treated as an infinite certificate. Previously published intact-biclique baseline is credited.
scientific_limitations: Three named colours; equal sides n>=4 and 0<=t<=n matching deletions only; gives minimum forcing sizes and their counts, not every coefficient. No independent validation or definitive bibliographic priority determination.
title: A single missing bipartite edge collapses the three-colour forcing seed threshold
